div.div: Evaluator truth must not enter IF-SELECT-ADMIT, IF-PRED-OBS, IF-HIST-UPDATE, or IF-EXECUTE-RECORD. IF-OBS-INTERPRET, IF-PREP-RECOVER, IF-EQUIV, and IF-RESOURCE-STOP stay algorithm-visible only. Experiment I/O: IF-EXP-SCENE, IF-EXP-INJECT, IF-EXP-TRUTH, IF-EXP-COLLECT, IF-EXP-RUN, IF-EXP-FILTER, IF-EXP-EVAL.
